what: The database identities (name + domain-tagged sha256 of pg_control_system().system_identifier, exactly as the census stamps `db_identity`) of the PRODUCTION cluster. A census run that DECLARES itself an evaluation copy (SUVARNA_EVAL_COPY) is refused when the server it is connected to has one of these identities: a port number is a weak proof of which database you are on (a proxy can be pointed anywhere), a restored cluster has a new system identifier, production's does not change.

identities.recorded_from: the db_identity stamp of the full production censuses census_final/{1b6734e91, 5124c348a, 622ec06e3, a98d904b5, b87dafbed, FINAL} (all six carry this identity)
